fields.description: Primary warehouse location used as the default source for material requests when no specific warehouse is designated.
fields.label: Default Set From Warehouse

fields.description: Configuration settings for integrating with the Common Unix Printing System (CUPS) server. CUPS handles all printing operations including pick lists, identifier labels, and inventory reports throughout the pick stream process.
fields.label: CUPS Settings

fields.description: IP address or hostname of the CUPS print server. This should be the network address where your CUPS server is running, typically in format like '192.168.1.100' or 'print-server.company.com'.
fields.label: Host

fields.description: Network port number for CUPS server communication. Standard CUPS port is 631, but may vary depending on your server configuration and security requirements.
fields.label: Port

fields.description: Configure item classification rules for barcode scanning and inventory management. Define which types of items cannot be transported in standard crates due to size, weight, or special handling requirements, along with their unique barcode prefix identifiers.
fields.label: Barcode Settings

fields.description: Master table defining different categories of inventory items and their handling requirements.
fields.label: Item Types

fields.description: Configuration parameters for crate management within the pick stream system.
fields.label: Crate Settings

fields.description: Primary warehouse configuration settings that control default behavior for material sourcing and inventory allocation.
fields.label: Warehouse Settings

fields.description: Main warehouse configuration tab containing all settings related to inventory sourcing, default locations, and material request handling within the pick stream system.
fields.label: Warehouse Settings

fields.description: Print server integration tab for configuring CUPS connectivity, printer management, and document formatting settings used throughout the pick stream workflow.
fields.label: CUPS Settings

fields.description: Container management tab for defining crate specifications, capacity planning, and automated handling rules that govern material transportation through the pick stream system.
fields.label: Crate Settings
